title: What's New: Working with Instructions for Agents in Business Central

chapters.title: Structuring Instructions with Guidelines and Business Processes
Sales Returns Task Setup and Document Processing
Agent Review Experience and Credit Memo Creation
Instructions versus task messages in agent design

features.name: Agent Instructions Framework
features.description: A structured approach to writing agent instructions for Business Central using role-based prompting, guidelines sections, and business-specific instructions. The strategy emphasizes less verbose instructions compared to previous approaches.
caveats: Instructions are wrapped in a larger platform-provided prompt
Platform handles model changes and security

features.name: Accounts Receivable Agent
features.description: A demo agent created for automating tasks in the accounts receivable area, including handling sales returns and processing customer complaints about damaged items.
caveats: Super permission set used for demo purposes
Full accounts receivable administrator profile may impact agent speed and accuracy

features.name: PDF and Image Document Intelligence
features.description: The platform can send PDFs and images to Azure Document Intelligence to extract text, allowing agents to analyze documents like invoices and damage photos without requiring traditional coding.
caveats: Platform only extracts text, not machine vision capabilities
Cannot identify visual patterns like circles on images

features.name: Agent Review Experience
features.description: A user interface experience where users can review agent-filled fields with explanations for why the agent took specific actions before submitting or providing feedback.
caveats: Requires user to manually continue task execution
Not automatic

features.name: Agent Task Execution with Real-time Monitoring
features.description: Agents execute tasks step-by-step with real-time monitoring capability where users can refresh and watch agent actions as they happen, with ability to pause and provide guidance.
caveats: Users can provide in-task guidance to correct agent behavior
Task stops when agent encounters issues or generates outgoing messages

features.name: Credit Memo Generation from Agent Instructions
features.description: Agent automatically creates and populates credit memo documents based on instructions and extracted information from source documents, filling customer information, item rows, and work descriptions.
caveats: Requires user review before posting
Agent can generate fraud detection prompts

features.name: Email Composition by Agent
features.description: Agent composes email messages to customers summarizing transactions and actions taken, with user ability to edit before sending.
caveats: Automatic sending requires SDK implementation
Manual sending only in current platform version

features.name: Instructions Priority Over Tasks
features.description: Platform design gives significantly higher priority to instructions compared to task-specific information, ensuring consistent agent behavior across multiple task executions.
caveats: Creates different behavior compared to task-focused information
Requires strategic instruction design

features.name: Timeline substeps based on instructions
features.description: When instructions are structured as substeps, the platform automatically uses them to provide captions for specific substeps in the agent timeline.
caveats: beginning and ending messages cannot be controlled without SDK
substep captions are automatically generated based on instruction structure

features.name: Task chaining in agent workflows
features.description: Agents can reference and chain multiple tasks, where one task can trigger the next task to execute, allowing complex multi-step workflows.
caveats: no silver bullet rule for agent size
adding more instructions can lower accuracy if tasks are too different

features.name: User intervention tool
features.description: Agent can request user assistance when it encounters an issue and cannot proceed independently, such as when unable to locate required documents.

features.name: User review tool
features.description: Agent requests user review after successfully completing a task to verify the work is correct before proceeding.

features.name: Response tool for outgoing messages
features.description: Agent can generate outgoing messages with attached files and halt task execution until new messages arrive, for internal or external communication.
caveats: message delivery method must be implemented via SDK
task stops until new message arrives

features.name: Automatic agent memory and history
features.description: Agent automatically retains and stores all history of actions taken, including search results, whether information was found or not.
caveats: page state is not automatically stored
user must instruct agent which fields and data to memorize

features.name: Agent memory field storage
features.description: Users can instruct the agent to memorize specific fields and data using natural language, storing them as key-value pairs for later reference in instructions.
caveats: requires explicit instruction to store page state
accessible via troubleshooting page

features.name: Page-specific instructions syntax
features.description: Developers can write page-specific instructions using parenthesis notation with page ID, making instructions available only when the agent opens that specific page.
caveats: instructions not present on other pages

features.name: Instructions history and versioning
features.description: Users can view edit history of instructions and revert to previous versions if changes negatively impact agent accuracy.

features.name: Bulk download of instructions
features.description: Users can select and download multiple instructions as a zip file for backup or sharing purposes.
